source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — private carriers cannot deliver to PO Box
source_extracts.quote: UPS, FedEx, Amazon and other private carriers cannot deliver to a PO Box

source_extracts.label: Amazon Seller Forums — Buy Shipping excludes USPS for PO Box orders
source_extracts.quote: For MF orders that ship to a PO Box, using the standard "PO Box ####" format for an address, Amazon won't allow a USPS solution for a label because "USPS does not validate a PO Box so Buy Shipping labels are not available".

source_extracts.label: Amazon staff reply — USPS delivers to PO Boxes
source_extracts.quote: USPS delivers to PO Boxes located in USPS post offices.

source_extracts.label: Amazon Seller Forums — workaround via street address + box as unit
source_extracts.quote: Another option is to buy shipping off Amazon and use the street address of the post office and the PO Box number as the unit number.

source_extracts.label: Supply Chain Dive — USPS/Amazon same-day pilot
source_extracts.quote: USPS and Amazon launched a same-day delivery pilot (confirmed by Amazon spokesperson, published Sept 30 2026)

source_extracts.label: Mailbox Plus pricing
source_extracts.quote: $25 plan includes 10 packages a month with carrier delivery and signing

source_extracts.label: USPS Notice 123 — PO Box retail fees
source_extracts.quote: Smallest PO Box at local post offices runs about $21 for three months

Third-party form acceptance is never categorical

scope_rules.forbid: any claim that Amazon itself delivers parcels to PO Boxes
scope_rules.reason: USPS FAQ confirms private carriers including Amazon cannot deliver to PO Boxes; forum consensus confirms USPS handles last-mile to PO Boxes.

scope_rules.forbid: stating Amazon 'will not' or 'never' offers USPS labels for PO Boxes on Buy Shipping as universal policy
scope_rules.reason: Seller reports show it is intermittent/validation-driven; some sellers report USPS Buy Shipping to PO Boxes works. Soften to 'often'/'in many cases', attributed to documented seller reports.
Forbidden superlatives, unverified turnaround promises, and unverified volume/experience counts per approved_store_claims.

scope_rules.forbid: any numeric claim not present in numeric_claims above
scope_rules.reason: Precision mandate: only ledger/source-backed numbers may be registered.
Forbidden categorical claim that every tier includes package receiving or 24/7 access; only the $25 tier's 10-package allowance is verified.
Search-volume figures are internal gate data, not customer-facing facts.
